entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Du Jiahao is a Chinese politician, serving since 2016 as the Party Secretary of Hunan. He served between 2013 and 2016 as the Governor of Hunan. Before that, he served as Vice Governor of Heilongjiang province, and also held many positions in Shanghai, including party chief of the Pudong New Area.
